description:
Supermarkets, convenience stores, fresh food shops, newsagents, hardware and clothing stores: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/shopping`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_supermarkets, per_1000_supermarkets, nearest_km_supermarkets, count_convenience_stores, per_1000_convenience_stores, nearest_km_convenience_stores, count_fresh_food, per_1000_fresh_food, nearest_km_fresh_food, count_newsagents, per_1000_newsagents, nearest_km_newsagents, count_hardware_stores, per_1000_hardware_stores, nearest_km_hardware_stores, count_clothing_stores, per_1000_clothing_stores, nearest_km_clothing_stores, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_amenities_shopping
title: Suburb · Shopping and retail
